newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle trade lively at $72 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle trade lively at $72 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was fairly actie near mmidday Wednesday, with saughter steers and heifers $1.00 per cwt higher, USDA said. Inquiry good, demand moderate.

Sales confirmed on 10,300 slaughter steers and 4,100 slaughter heifers Wednesday. For the week to date 29,000 head confirmed including 8,700 head or about 30 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.

Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink. Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1325 lbs 72.00. Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 72.00, couple pens 1000-1050 lbs 71.50. Confirmed - 14,400.
